correctness.rationale: Automorphism orbits of three pebbled nonzero matrix units correspond to equality partitions of at most six underlying row/column index labels, plus zero positions. When moving a pebble, at most four labels remain; adding two labels is always possible at n≥6, so the 3-pebble game is preserved for all depths and all m,n≥6. Independent complete orbit computation enumerated 255 canonical three-variable patterns, all substitution successors, and rank refinement [1,2,3,5,6] stabilizing at rank4, with B5 and B6 first distinguished there. A separate source direct concrete-state verifier supplies additional finite cross-check. The finite classification is not extrapolated to unbounded indices; the 6-label back-and-forth argument proves that part.
residual_risks: The independently reconstructed orbit calculation is exact for its finite states; no unaudited opaque executable was run.
